scenario: The ego vehicle travels on a straight two-lane road when a taxi suddenly pulls out from the left side, cutting across the ego's path to merge into the same lane ahead.

ego.behavior: The car travels straight forward along its lane and decelerates to avoid collision with the merging taxi.

adversarials.behavior: The taxi pulls out from a concealed position on the left roadside, crosses the ego's lane, and merges ahead of the ego vehicle in the same direction of travel.

spatial_relation: The ego vehicle is on a straight two-lane road with trees and bushes lining the left side, and the adversarial taxi emerges from a gap in the left roadside vegetation to cut across the ego's path.
requirements_and_restrictions: The ego vehicle must maintain a safe following distance after the taxi merges; the scenario terminates once the ego has stabilized behind the merged taxi or traveled past the merge point.

road_side_structures.position: Positioned on the right side of the road, visible in the distance along the roadside.

reasoning_chain: 1. Actors: Ego is the camera-host vehicle; the blue taxi is the sole adversarial. 2. Chronology: Initially ego approaches straight road. Midpoint, taxi emerges from left roadside vegetation. Ending, taxi completes merge ahead of ego. 3. Evidence: Taxi's position shifts from hidden left to directly ahead; ego's speed drops from 60 to 52 km/h during merge.
